scores.rationale: The candidate initially implemented the wrong message and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`) in its DoD and acceptance tests instead of the ticket's specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, and `ConversationListMessage` (though it mentions `StoreCannotList` and `UNSUPPORTED` in the changelog, the public types exported in `src/index.ts` and tested in `conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` use the wrong names). Furthermore, the candidate's acceptance test and implementation log the raw error message (`error: 'database offline'`) on `listFor` rejection instead of omitting store details, and validate `limit` as non-negative (allowing 0 or >200) instead of enforcing 1–200 as required by the acceptance criteria. It also missed adding the `## Conversation List` prose section to `docs/getting-started.md`, threading `history` in `createHalEngine` (`src/config.ts`), and adding startup warnings when `history` is enabled without `resume`. While the general plumbing through `createServer`, `messageHandler`, and non-locked execution follows the right architectural seams, the wrong protocol frame names and validation bounds make it incompatible with the specification.
